scope: Owner-requested newer-model comparison; all outputs exploratory, no clinical decisions
protein_score: masked log probability of alternate minus reference residue; natural log; lower means less sequence-compatible

protein_controls.source_panel: Main text referring to Figure S3C

protein_gate.rule: D882N must score strictly higher than every primary_impaired control in every prespecified window; numerical repeat difference <= 0.000001
protein_gate.candidate_inference: All prespecified candidates are diagnostic outputs, even for a failed control gate; never select only passing models for the ensemble. No clinical interpretation from failed qualification.
protein_gate.no_reselection: Use all seven models and all three windows; no replacement or score-direction change after results. Checkpoint 1 results were already observed.
protein_gate.interpretation: A conservative resource-allocation gate, not validated sensitivity/specificity or a pathogenicity threshold

protein_precision: float32 with TF32 disabled for masked language scores; default documented folding precision recorded separately

alphafold3.msa: existing public-WT-derived 623-record alignment, query row changed only for synthetic substitution

metrics: all-seed WT-WT and WT-alternate CA RMSD
structures.interpretation: Structure resemblance or confidence is not folding stability, protein abundance, enzymatic activity or functional rescue. Compare all controls and all seeds, not best-ranked structures. Three seeds are sampling variability, not biological replicates.

evo2.scope: Owner-requested Evo 2 DNA-sequence sensitivity comparison, fixed before model scores
evo2.runtime: Evo 2 0.6.0, Vortex 1.1.0, torch 2.6.0+cu124, FlashAttention 2.8.0.post2; 7B supported BF16, 40B required Transformer Engine FP8; no approximate kernel override
evo2.benchmark: Public Findlay 2018 BRCA1 saturation genome editing table and public GRCh37 chr17 distributed with official Evo2 notebook
evo2.selection: Exclude intermediate/non-SNV; sort SHA256(20260920:BRCA1:position:REF>ALT); choose first 48 FUNC and 48 LOF with at most one alternate per genomic site across both classes
evo2.score: mean autoregressive log likelihood alternate minus reference, no BOS; retain forward and reverse-complement scores separately and their average; same as upstream mean-reduction method
evo2.numerical_gate: Official built-in forward-test mean loss within 0.001 of checkpoint expected value; repeat reference score difference <=0.000001; finite outputs required. Stop runtime if numerical gate fails.
evo2.functional_gate: Descriptive BRCA1 AUROC using negative mean-strand delta >=0.70 and LOF median delta lower than FUNC; this is a resource qualification, not clinical validation or a gene-transfer guarantee
evo2.candidate_inference: Diagnostic outputs retained for both prespecified models even if functional gate fails; no candidate inference on a failed numerical gate. No selecting passing models, windows or strands after seeing results.
evo2.candidate_source: Permitted ranked-pair report notes/track2-report-v12.md; no VCF access
evo2.reference_source: Public Ensembl REST GRCh38 forward-strand sequence; REF/length/alphabet checks before transfer; alternate is synthetic
